create_cache_method: create a cache_method decorator to add caching to async or sync methods with sampling support
build_simple_function_cache: build a thread-safe SimpleFunctionCache that persists cached values to a JSON file
create_two_layer_cache: create a TwoLayerCache combining a fast L1 in-memory cache with a slower L2 file-based cache
run_sampling_key_updater: run a SamplingKeyUpdater executable to set and restore sampling keys around wrapped async operations
diff_cache_data: diff two _CacheData objects to find differences in counters, values, and sampling key mappings
